prerequisites.no_fund: Create a fund first to access fund payments.

patient.title: Patients
patient.description: Manage the list of patients registered in the application.

funds.title: Funds
funds.description: Manage the affiliated funds associated with patients and procedures.

procedure_types.title: Procedure Types
procedure_types.description: Manage the medical procedure types used during data entry.

fund_payment.title: Fund Payment
fund_payment.description: View and manage fund payment groups.

direct_payments.title: Direct payments
direct_payments.description: View and manage procedure payments by check, bank card or cash.

fund_wires.title: Fund wires
fund_wires.description: View and manage the wires funds send to settle their payment groups.

bank_account.title: Bank Accounts
bank_account.description: Manage bank accounts used for reconciliation.

bank_statement_label.title: Statement labels
bank_statement_label.description: Review, correct or delete the fund linked to a bank statement label.

patient_duplicates.title: Duplicate patients
patient_duplicates.description: Find patient records that carry the same name, and merge them or mark them as different people.
